review_candidates.title: API Connect / Integration Developer
review_candidates.description: Job Title: API Connect / Integration Developer Location: Egypt (assignment-specific work model confirmed during selection) Employment Type: ITGoals delivery engagement (final contractual model confirmed during selection) Seniority: Mid to Senior Openings: 1 About ITGoals ITGoals is an Egypt-based enterprise software and technology delivery company with 17+ years of experience. We provide dedicated engineering teams, ERP and SAP services, product engineering, software development, and nearshore/outsourcing delivery for organizations across the GCC, Europe, the United States, and the wider region. Our financial-services work spans secure platforms and technology delivery for banking, payments, digital channels, integration, data, and financial operations. The Role Design, publish, secure, operate, and troubleshoot enterprise APIs using IBM API Connect , enabling controlled integration between digital channels, workflow platforms, backend services, and core enterprise systems. You'll join a structured delivery team on complex, production-critical financial-services programs — the kind of work where security, resilience, and traceability are not optional. What You'll Do Design, publish, configure, and support APIs through IBM API Connect in line with enterprise integration and security standards Define API contracts, request/response structures, mapping logic, routing, transformations, and controlled exposure of backend capabilities Configure gateway policies for authentication, authorization, throttling, validation, transformation, routing, logging, and error handling Implement and support API security using OAuth, JWT, API keys, certificates, and related enterprise security mechanisms Work with REST APIs, JSON, XML, headers, status codes, and integration protocols required by connected systems Manage certificates and environment-specific configuration under secure deployment and change-management practices Test APIs, validate functional and non-functional behavior, and support QA and UAT teams during release cycles Monitor API behavior and troubleshoot gateway errors, connectivity issues, mapping problems, authorization failures, performance concerns, and downstream service errors Collaborate with architects, application developers, workflow teams, security teams, DevOps, and infrastructure teams to deliver stable integrations Document API specifications, policies, dependencies, deployment requirements, and support information Experience Hands-on experience with enterprise API management or integration platforms, ideally IBM API Connect Delivering and supporting REST-based APIs in production environments Practical exposure to API security, gateway policies, certificates, and integration troubleshooting Ability to diagnose issues across gateway, network, application, and downstream-service boundaries Required Skills IBM API Connect REST APIs OAuth, JWT, and API Key security Gateway policies and routing JSON / XML transformation and mapping Certificates and secure connectivity API testing, monitoring, and troubleshooting Error handling and production-support practices Nice to Have Banking, fintech, payments, open banking, digital channels, or other regulated integration experience — a strong advantage OpenAPI / Swagger specification design Java / Spring Boot or microservices integration experience OpenShift, containers, CI/CD, or automated API deployment Experience with high-volume, business-critical APIs and performance monitoring What Success Looks Like You treat APIs as governed enterprise products, not simple endpoints You balance integration speed with security, stability, traceability, and supportability You isolate complex integration problems quickly and communicate root cause clearly Enterprise-scale assignments where engineering quality, security, resilience, and delivery discipline matter Structured recruitment, onboarding, delivery governance, and clear professional ownership throughout the engagement Collaboration with experienced engineers, architects, QA professionals, delivery leaders, and business stakeholders Exposure to complex digital-transformation environments — deepen banking, fintech, payments, and regulated-enterprise experience Long-term enterprise delivery program opportunities based on performance, business demand, and role fit How to Apply Share an updated CV highlighting your enterprise delivery experience, banking / fintech exposure where applicable, and the technologies listed above. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for next steps.
